correctness.rationale: Tufo proves the codimension-two blow-up description and gives the middle cohomology rank. The Gysin self-intersection formula makes the exceptional middle pairing the negative Enriques form and makes it orthogonal to the pullback of the ambient middle cohomology. The ambient matrix is \(U\oplus\langle1\rangle\), while the Enriques free lattice is \(U\oplus E_8(-1)\). Their sum is odd unimodular of signature \((11,2)\); the classification of indefinite odd unimodular lattices gives \(I_{11,2}\). The bundled exact matrix check confirms rank, determinant, parity, and inertia.

value.rationale: The middle integral pairing is a natural structural invariant of a smooth Fano fourfold and is not determined by the additive cohomology group. The exact isometry \(I_{11,2}\) packages parity, unimodularity, and signature in a complete lattice classification, giving reusable topological information for comparisons of this new Enriques Fano host.
